public_holidays.name: Christmas Eve (Štědrý den)
public_holidays.shops: Shops over 200 sq m must close from 12:00 (finance.cz, 19 Dec 2024, citing the retail opening-hours act, which is Act 223/2016 Coll.; the article prints '223/2026', a typo). Smaller shops, petrol stations, pharmacies and shops at stations/airports are exempt. Markets on Old Town and Wenceslas Squares: see markets.

markets.closed_or_special: 24, 25, 26, 31 Dec and 1 Jan hours are NOT on the organiser's 2026 page. kudyznudy.cz (state tourism portal) lists 24 Dec 10:00-14:00 and 25-26 Dec 12:00-22:00, and says the footbridge in the central part of the square is closed to the public 22:00 on 31 Dec to 09:00 on 1 Jan. The 24 Dec 10:00-14:00 figure matches the 2025 market (České noviny, 20 Dec 2025). Treat 24-26 Dec hours as 'secondary / latest year (2025)'. Tree lighting Sat 28 Nov 2026 (organiser): time NOT stated; the tree is lit hourly in the evening daily 16:30-21:30 per kudyznudy (2026 time not confirmed). Tree contest results announced 1 Nov 2026.
